subject: Field mapping and export options for admin activity evidence
messages:

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Field mapping and export options for admin activity evidence

Hi Soojin / team,

We're preparing for an upcoming SIG + SOC 2 re-assessment and the auditors asked for a concrete mapping of admin activity events to controls, plus sample exports. Specifically they want:

- A column-level field list (what exactly is logged: actor id, actor role, timestamp, api_endpoint, request_id, change_before, change_after, tenant_id, ip, user_agent, session_id, etc.)
- Example export files and preferred formats (CSV/NDJSON/Parquet)
- Delivery/transport options and whether you can generate signed manifests/HMACs for integrity verification
- Retention windows by event class and any redaction/anonymization options available at export time

Attached is a rough spreadsheet (requested_fields_matrix.xlsx) that the audit team will use to check that our responses map to SIG questions. Can you confirm the fields you can provide, default retention periods, and recommended transport? Also let us know if there are per-tenant scoping filters and whether PII can be redacted during extraction.

We'd like to turn this around within 72 hours if possible. Auditors are flexible on format but will insist on an attested manifest.

Thanks,
Aisha Desai
Compliance Manager
Dravis Health

---

Hi Aisha — thanks for the note and the spreadsheet. We can definitely produce a mapping and provide sample exports. Quick clarifying Qs before we prepare the deliverables:

1) Do auditors need the full 365-day live export or a snapshot for a defined window (they mentioned "last 90 days" as an example)?
2) Do you need per-tenant manifests (one file per tenant) or a single exported bundle with tenant_id as a column?
3) Any regulatory constraints we should be aware of (e.g., export must be to your SFTP, or we should avoid cloud share links)?

I'll pull together a sample manifest (CSV) and an export instructions PDF that walks through HMAC signing and delivery options. If you can confirm the above, we'll target a two-business-day turnaround.

Best,

Thanks, Soojin. Good questions — apologies for not including details earlier.

- Auditors want a full snapshot covering the last 12 months but they'll sample for the last 90 days during on-site review. Ideally we get a 12-month bundle plus a small 90-day sample export.
- They prefer a per-tenant manifest for multi-tenant customers — that makes their traceability checks easier.
- Transport: they prefer SFTP to our secure ingest box. If you can also provide an attested Drive link as a backup that's fine, but SFTP is preferred.

For the attestation: they will validate SHA256 checksums and prefer signed manifests (HMAC with a shared secret or PGP signature). Also attached a short doc from the audit firm listing minimum expectations (auditor_requirements.pdf).

Can your export manifest include a checksum column and a separate manifest signature file?

Cheers,
Aisha
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@dravishealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Field mapping and export options for admin activity evidence

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clarifications. Below is a concise inventory and our recommended export pattern. I copied Jonas and Kimberly for visibility on retention and delivery ops.

What we log (high level, column examples):
- Authentication events: actor_id, actor_email, actor_role, timestamp_utc, ip_address, user_agent, auth_method (sso|password|api_key), success
- Session lifecycle: session_id, created_at, last_activity_at, terminated_at, tenant_id
- Admin API calls / config changes: event_id, request_id, actor_id, actor_role, api_endpoint, method, target_resource_id, change_before, change_after, timestamp_utc, tenant_id
- RBAC / role changes: change_type (grant|revoke), role_name, actor_id, affected_user_id, timestamp_utc, tenant_id
- Key and secret events: key_id, action (create|rotate|revoke), actor_id, timestamp_utc (payloads/redacted)
- Privileged console actions: page_url, action_summary, affected_resource_id, timestamp_utc, actor_id

Default retention and options:
- Default retention: 365 days for admin events.
- Long-term archive: We can provide 3-year archive snapshots on request (cold storage export).
- Redaction: PII fields (full email, IP) can be redacted or hashed at export time. We can also pseudonymize actor identifiers per-tenant.

Export formats and delivery:
- Formats: NDJSON (recommended), CSV (auditor-friendly), Parquet (compressed analytic bundle).
- Checksums: SHA256 per file + a manifest.csv listing file_name, sha256_hex, rows_count, tenant_id.
- Signing: HMAC-SHA256 with shared key or PGP signature — your preference.
- Delivery: SFTP with ephemeral credentials (recommended), signed Google Drive link (expiring), or secure HTTPS pull with pre-signed URL.
- Per-tenant: we can produce one file per tenant and include tenant_id in the manifest for mapping.

Sampling and scope:
- We can produce the full 12-month bundle plus a 90-day sample subset. Sampling preserves row order and request_id integrity.
- For chain-of-custody, we generate a signed, time-stamped manifest and provide transfer logs showing when the file was uploaded + checksum verification on our side.

Operational notes and timeline:
- We'll produce a sample manifest + one tenant CSV/NDJSON export within 24 hours of confirmation.
- Full 12-month export will be scheduled (estimated 2 business days depending on bundle size).

Attachments included: admin_event_manifest.csv (example), export_instructions.pdf (walkthrough for HMAC and SFTP).

If this looks good, let's schedule a 60-minute working session with your auditors and our delivery ops to walk through the manifest and transport. I'm available tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PT or Friday afternoon.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
